INTRO_TITLE: AZWAR — D ACHU I PI NETWORK?
INTRO_P1: Pi Network d asenfar n idrimen digiṭal d ecosystem amaḍlan i yettwabnan i wakken ad yili cryptocurrency d ayen yesshlen i medden n tikkelt.
INTRO_P2: Mgal tiyyaḍ n crypto iqbuṛen i yesra makina n tfellaxt s wazal aɣlayen d trisiti aṭas, Pi Network issir i medden ad tekkin s tilifun-nsen.
INTRO_P3: Tamuɣli n Pi Network d asali n ecosystem s ufus n medden anda idrimen digiṭal zemren ad ttusqedcent i umahil n tidett, i tmehla n tidett, i tuddsa n tidett d tekkist n tdamsa n tidett.
M1: Bennu tadamsa ta digiṭalt i yesduklen medden akk
M2: Rnu tazmert i medden n tikkelt deg umaḍal
M3: Snerni aseqdec deg tudert n tidett
M4: Adeggir n ubdil gar afgan d afgan
CH1_SUB: Ansuf yis-wen gha Asinag n Uselmed n Imezwura n Tefriqt - Beṛṛa. Tagnit-a tettwabna i uselmed, i asnerni d uheggi n imezwura n Tefriqt d imsenzanen i tekki taqburt deg Pi Ecosystem.
REG2: Kles s Facebook neɣ Uṭun n Tilifun
DAILY_MINING: Tifellaxt n wass: Uɣal-d yal 24 n ssaɛa i wakken ad tkecmeḍ tifellaxt.
WALLET_SEC: Taɣellist n Wallet: Ur tbeṭṭu ara 24 n wawalen n Passphrase-nnek. Win yesɛan awalen-a d netta d bab n wallet.
CH2_DESC: Lemmed amek ara trecceḍ d umazan n Pi s tɣellist s Pi Wallet deg Pi Browser.
CH2A_TITLE: IXEF 2A — ASELMED N PI WALLET S UFUS
CH2A_DESC: Bdu s wazal amectuḥ n uɛṛaḍ, ssenqed tansa, ur tbeṭṭu ara passphrase-nnek.
CH3_DESC: Pi Browser DApps d iprogrammen ur yettwafren ara i useqdec n tidett.
CH4_DESC: Af-d tidamsin i iqeblen Pi deg umaḍal akk.
CH5_DESC: Azal n Umtawa Amaḍlan (GCV) issenkar aseqdec n tidett deg ecosystem.
CH6_DESC: Ɣer adlis n Doris Yin i usnulfu n useqdec d umɣur n ecosystem.
MERCHANT_DESC: Amek ara tekcmeḍ deg ecosystem, sskles tamsirt-ik ghef MapOfPi, qbel aɣal n Pi.
FINAL_P: Tefriqt tesɛa tagnit ad tuɣal d yiwet seg tmnaḍin iǧehden deg useqdec n tidett deg Pi Ecosystem. Akken a Nebnu. Akken a Nselmed. Akken a Nerr Tazmert i Tefriqt s Pi.
